rules: Only quotes we have checked against a named source. 'source' is kept here for honesty but not shown in the popup. 'link' is where the name points.

quotes.text: I would argue that there is no objective perception of value whatsoever.
quotes.source: WIRED, 'Marketing Expert Answers Marketing Questions From The Internet' (YouTube), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Quite simply, the experience of adopting any new technology is the opposite of having children.
quotes.source: The Spectator, 'Nothing beats a 1980s brick phone', via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Most company mergers fail, so let's not be absolutely naive about the benefits of scale.
quotes.source: Nudge podcast, 'It's the mistake EVERY business makes', via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Never write an advertisement which you wouldn't want your own family to read.
quotes.source: Confessions of an Advertising Man, p. 87, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: When I write an advertisement, I don't want you to tell me that you find it 'creative'. I want you to find it so interesting that you buy the product.
quotes.source: Ogilvy on Advertising, p. 7, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: I have learned that any fool can write a bad ad, but that it takes a real genius to keep his hands off a good one.
quotes.source: Leo Burnett company quote collection (quote 38), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Fun without sell gets nowhere, but sell without fun tends to become obnoxious.
quotes.source: Communications of an Advertising Man (1961), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Make it simple. Make it memorable.
quotes.source: Leo Burnett company quote collection (quote 65), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: We never want anything so much as when we can't have it.
quotes.source: Dave Trott's blog, 'Don't regret what you didn't do', 16 Nov 2026 (davetrott.co.uk/2026/11/dont-regret-what-you-didnt-do/)

quotes.text: The internet has become a channel to harvest, rather than build, brands.
quotes.source: No Mercy / No Malice, 'Alexa, How Can We Kill Brands?', 12 May 2017 (profgalloway.com)

quotes.text: The sun has passed midday on the brand era.
quotes.source: No Mercy / No Malice, 'Alexa, How Can We Kill Brands?', 12 May 2017 (profgalloway.com)

quotes.text: A lot of times, people don't know what they want until you show it to them.
quotes.source: BusinessWeek, 25 May 1998, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Real artists ship.
quotes.source: Epigram from the Macintosh team, in 'West of Eden' (1989), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Nothing in life is as important as you think it is when you are thinking about it.
quotes.source: Thinking, Fast and Slow, ch. 38, p. 402, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: No one ever made a decision because of a number. They need a story.
quotes.source: Quoted in Michael Lewis, 'The Undoing Project' (2016), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: We view a behavior as more correct in a given situation to the degree that we see others performing it.
quotes.source: Influence: The Psychology of Persuasion (1984), social proof chapter, as quoted by Farnam Street (fs.blog) and others

quotes.text: Advertising is 80% idea and 80% execution.
quotes.source: Poster of his own line on his wall at BBH, Business Insider, May 2016

quotes.text: A business is a creative idea.
quotes.source: LBB Online, 'Ad Astra: Sir John Hegarty on creativity as an act of defiance', 2024

quotes.text: It's better to have a hundred people love you than to have a million people that just sort of like you.
quotes.source: Masters of Scale with Reid Hoffman (mastersofscale.com/brian-chesky). Chesky passing on advice he was given at Y Combinator

quotes.text: The first time people look at any given ad, they don't even see it.
quotes.source: 'Successful Advertising' (London, 1885), step 1 of his 20 steps, as quoted by Branding Strategy Insider. Modern wording.

quotes.text: Your margin is my opportunity.
quotes.source: Forbes, 'Amazon's Impending Invasion Of Banking', 8 Jul 2019, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: If you absolutely can't tolerate critics, then don't do anything new or interesting.
quotes.source: Code Conference 2016, reported by Boing Boing, 1 Jun 2016, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Good companies will meet needs; great companies will create markets.
quotes.source: Cited in Stuart Crainer, 'The 75 Greatest Management Decisions Ever Made' (2002), p. 37, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: There is only one valid definition of a business purpose: to create a customer.
quotes.source: The Practice of Management (1954), p. 37, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: When a device as simple as a door has to come with an instruction manual, even a one-word manual, then it is a failure, poorly designed.
quotes.source: The Design of Everyday Things, ch. 4, p. 87, via Wikiquote

quotes.text: Google never did any advertising. They're like dealers; they sell the stuff, but they know better than to use it themselves.
quotes.source: 'How to Start a Startup', March 2005 (paulgraham.com/start.html), via Wikiquote

quotes.text: The problem with competition is that it takes away the requirement to set your own path.
quotes.source: Seth's Blog, 'Competition as a crutch', 16 Jul 2012, via Wikiquote (shortened)
